summary: IPC Alternative Real Estate Income Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a quarterly distribution authorized by its Board for its common stock classes. Gross distributions range from $0.1042 per share across Classes T, D, I, and X-1, with net amounts after fees from $0.0877 to $0.1042. Record date is April 30, 2026, payable on or about May 5, 2026, in cash or reinvested under the distribution reinvestment plan. This is a routine dividend announcement, not a special situation event.
